item.title: Full Moon Hike Series — Wed Nov 25, 7:00 PM — Brown County State Park
item.description:
Things to know for night hikes: wear close toed shoes (not sandals) and dress for the weather. Red lights are preferred for night vision and can be loaned to hikers if necessary. Please do not bring pets on night hikes. Hikers must stay with the group on night hikes. Ogle Lake hikes use Trail 7 and are considered very rugged in the dark. Salt Creek Trail Hikes are considered moderate in the dark. Meet at the Olympic Pool for Salt Creek Hikes. For questions and detailed hike information, visit the Nature Center, call 812-988-5240, email the natralist at emajor@dnr.in.gov or visit on in.gov/BrownCountySP Schedule:
January 3rd, 7pm, Ogle Lake January 31st, 7pm, Salt Creek Trail February 28th, 7pm, Salt Creek Trail April 3rd, 8:30, Ogle Lake May 1st, 9pm, Ogle Lake May 30th, 9pm Salt Creek Trail Jun 27th, 9:30pm Salt Creek Trail July 31st, 9:30pm Ogle Lake August 28th, 8:30pm Ogle Lake September 26th, 7:30pm Salt Creek Trail October 24th, 7pm Salt Creek Trail December 23rd, 7pm Salt Creek

item.title: 2nd Weekend Work Day Trail Building — Sat Dec 12, 9:30 AM
item.description:
Knobstone Hiking Trail Association of Indiana Meetup Would you like to spend a day in some beautiful woods with a delightful group of people building a connecting section of Indiana’s premier long distance hiking trail? Come join us as we continue work on the Tecumseh Trail extension portion of the KHT in MMSF. We will be building the new trail including clipping green briar. Please bring a lunch and water. We will have large hand tools, but please bring any small tools you have such as clippers or a pruning saw. And a backpack is handy to carry everything in. Instructions will be provided for those who need them. We finish about 3:30. Meet at the parking lot at the base of Gose Creek Road at the end of Hinson Road in Martinsville. Join us on our website at http://www.knobstonehikingtrail.org/, on Facebook at [www.facebook.com/groups/2255586117953484](http://www.facebook.com/groups/2255586117953484), and Substack [https://khta.substack.com/](https://khta.substack.com/)
Source: Knobsto

item.title: The Fab Four — Sat Feb 20, 1:00 AM — 200 Maple Leaf Boulevard
item.description:
If you want to experience the best Beatles tribute ever, you won’t want to miss The Fab Four: The Ultimate Tribute, live at the Brown County Music Center in Nashville, Ind., on Friday, February 19, 2027. The Emmy Award Winning Fab Four is elevated far above every other Beatles Tribute due to their precise attention to detail. With uncanny, note-for-note live renditions of Beatles’ classics such as “Can’t Buy Me Love,” “Yesterday,” “A Day In The Life,” “Twist And Shout,” “Here Comes The Sun,” and “Hey Jude”, the Fab Four will make you think you are watching the real thing. Their incredible stage performances include three costume changes representing every era of the Beatles ever-changing career. This loving tribute to the Beatles has amazed audiences in countries around the world, including Japan, Australia, France, Hong Kong, The United Kingdom, Germany, Mexico and Brazil.
Source: Brown County Events
